apps.localizedDescription:
LANreader:

LANreader is an iOS/macOS(Apple silicon) manga reader for LANraragi.

The AppStore version is a paid app. You can still follow Test on your device section to install it on your device for free.

Deep links:

Other apps and shortcuts can open LANreader with links in the form lanreader://?=. Percent-encode every value.

Archive IDs come from the LANraragi server LANreader is connected to.

AltStore:

• Use AltStore Classic to install on your device.

Source Code:

• Clone this project.
• Open it in Xcode.

Use the repository commands so local development and Continuous Integration (CI) exercise the same checks:

• ./scripts/verify-changes selects the quickest safe verification tier for the current diff.
• ./scripts/verify runs repository validation, strict SwiftLint, and the complete iOS test suite.
